answer: Make each identity solve a memory-hard puzzle needing 2 GB of RAM, re-issued every epoch, to keep its seat. One honest agent pays it once on one machine; a farm of k fakes needs k times the memory, so cost grows linearly and cannot be shared across the zenith of a botnet. Each fake is a vertex needing its own machine, and a jetty of cheap bandwidth does not help. Weakness: rented cloud memory lets a rich attacker still scale.
